# AI-festen rammes af dommedagsfrygt

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on the sell-off in AI stocks after an Anthropic researcher quit and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing AI development. Hosts see the doomsday talk as partly true and partly a way for incumbents heading to IPO to push rules that keep rivals out, and Trump has rejected any slowdown. Macro is gloomy: oil is above $100 after an attack on a Saudi pipeline, and hosts expect a US rate hike this week because long yields keep climbing. Still, they think strong corporate earnings are carrying the market and suggest buying AI stocks on further weakness, paired with conventional software stocks as a hedge.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CRM — Salesforce | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Suggested as a hedge against volatile AI positions because it trades roughly inversely to AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

A host suggests pairing volatile AI bets with conventional software/service names without AI exposure, such as Salesforce, to cut broad market exposure. This is a portfolio-hedging idea rather than a view on the company itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI sell-off reverses and the inverse relationship weakens
- if AI disruption hits conventional software fundamentals

> *"de her software- og serviceaktier, som ikke har noget AI i sig, altså Salesforce, Adobe, Duolingo, DocuSign, alle de der aktier, de handler jo nærmest en til en omvendt af AI-aktierne"*
